data.name: Nehemion
data.long_meaning: Nehemion is derived from the Hebrew name Nehemiah, which means 'comforted by God' or 'consoler of the distressed'. In the Old Testament, Nehemiah was a Jewish leader who led the rebuilding of the walls of Jerusalem after the Israelites returned from exile. In the New Testament, Nehemion could symbolize the spiritual comfort and support that God provides to His people.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing divine comfort and spiritual support

in_hebrew.name: ניהמיון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ניהמיון הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'ניחם ה' על עם ישראל', שם שיכול להתפרש כ'ה' מנחם את עמו ישראל'. השם ניהמיון מורכב משתי מילים: 'נחם' שפירושו לנחם, ולשם 'ה' 'ישראל'.

in_greek.name: Νεημίου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Νεημίου είναι ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος ניהמיון, που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός παρηγορεί τον λαό' ή 'Ο Θεός παρηγορεί τον λαό Ισραήλ'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα σχετίζεται με το βιβλίο του Νεεμίου, που είναι ένα από τα βιβλία της Παλαιάς Διαθήκης.

in_latin.name: Nehemion
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Nehemion derivatur ex hebraeo nomine ניהמיון, quod significat 'Deus consolatur populum' vel 'Deus consolatur populum Israel'. Nomen hoc in traditione christiana est, et refertur ad librum Nehemiae in Vetere Testamento.

in_english.name: Nehemion
in_english.meaning: God comforts or consoles the people
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nehemion originates from the Hebrew name ניהמיון (Nehemiah), meaning 'God comforts or consoles the people'. It is derived from two Hebrew words: 'nehem' (נחם), meaning 'to comfort', and 'Yah' (יה), a shortened form of God's name. In the Christian tradition, Nehemion is associated with the biblical book of Nehemiah, which tells the story of a Jewish leader who helped rebuild Jerusalem's walls. The name symbolizes spiritual comfort, divine guidance, and leadership.

biblical_reference.note: The book of Nehemiah is part of the Old Testament and tells the story of Nehemiah, a Jewish priest who led the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nehemion, derived from the Hebrew name Nehemiah, is deeply rooted in the rich history of the Jewish people and their resilience. It is a name that carries the weight of leadership, courage, and determination. In the Old Testament, Nehemiah led the Israelites in rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem after their return from exile, demonstrating his unwavering commitment to his people and his faith. Today, the name Nehemion continues to evoke imagery of strength, perseverance, and courage in individuals who bear it.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nehemion, meaning 'comforted by God' or 'consoler of the distressed', holds tremendous spiritual significance. It is a reminder that, in times of hardship and distress, God is always with us, providing comfort and support. Nehemion represents the spiritual role of being a source of solace, encouragement, and strength for others in times of need.

historical_references.reference: Nehemiah led the Jewish exiles back to Jerusalem in 445 BC and supervised the rebuilding of the city walls.
